portInfo.description: GPA is the statutory port authority for St. George’s and other Grenadian harbours. Its public harbour notes place St George’s at 12°03′N, 61°45′W on the south-west coast, describe the Carenage and Lagoon basins sharing an entrance, and note ISPS implementation at the Port of St. George’s in 2004. A dedicated “cruise terminus” path on grenadaports.com returned HTTP 404 during this research, so published LOA, pier names and passenger-door coordinates are not invented from older secondary guides. Confirm which pier/pontoon your ship uses on the day.
portInfo.currency: Eastern Caribbean Dollar (XCD), US Dollar accepted

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Carenage / market streets — ~90–120 min if walk-off allowed.
Fort George views — climb minutes unverified.
Spice / waterfall tours — coach; standard+ calls.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Do not trust outdated “Melville Street LOA” tables until GPA republishes a terminus sheet.
